title: 台灣高速鐵路~Taiwan High Speed Rail
focus: 高速鐵路車軌橋與地震系統介面~High speed vehicle track bridge and seismic interfaces
summary: 以臺灣南北高速運輸走廊為背景，設計一段包含高架橋、曲線與隧道的教學路線。比較正常行車、地震警報和異常受電三種工況，要求學徒追蹤每項設計假設如何傳到停車位置與班表恢復。~Use Taiwan’s north-south high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented alignment with a viaduct, curve and tunnel. Compare routine running, an earthquake warning and disrupted current collection. Trace each design assumption through to stopping position and timetable recovery rather than treating vehicle, structure and control calculations as isolated answers.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 distance=3675 m；單元 2 得 residual=0.1152 m/s^2；單元 3 得 compression=72.45 MPa。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 v 的擾動測試，結果改為 4427.5 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以臺灣南北高速運輸走廊為背景，設計一段包含高架橋、曲線與隧道的教學路線。比較正常行車、地震警報和異常受電三種工況，要求學徒追蹤每項設計假設如何傳到停車位置與班表恢復。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives distance=3675 m; unit 2 gives residual=0.1152 m/s^2; unit 3 gives compression=72.45 MPa. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing v in the first unit changes its result to 4427.5 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Taiwan’s north-south high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented alignment with a viaduct, curve and tunnel. Compare routine running, an earthquake warning and disrupted current collection. Trace each design assumption through to stopping position and timetable recovery rather than treating vehicle, structure and control calculations as isolated answers. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：臺灣高鐵開始提供營運服務；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以臺灣南北高速運輸走廊為背景，設計一段包含高架橋、曲線與隧道的教學路線。比較正常行車、地震警報和異常受電三種工況，要求學徒追蹤每項設計假設如何傳到停車位置與班表恢復。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: Taiwan High Speed Rail began passenger service; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Taiwan’s north-south high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented alignment with a viaduct, curve and tunnel. Compare routine running, an earthquake warning and disrupted current collection. Trace each design assumption through to stopping position and timetable recovery rather than treating vehicle, structure and control calculations as isolated answers. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.title: 延遲與制動距離~Delay and braking distance
units.mechanism: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 把警報後的列車停車位置與橋梁邊界放在同一里程圖上。~A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Plot the post-alarm stopping position and bridge limits on the same chainage diagram.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 77 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4427.5 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 77 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4427.5 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded.
units.verify: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。~Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges.
units.failure: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。~Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.
units.misconception: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成~A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
units.practice: 分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.mechanism: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較快車通過與低速受限運轉時相同曲線的殘餘側向加速度。~On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare residual lateral acceleration on one curve during fast passage and restricted low-speed operation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=60 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.1152 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 66 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3042 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=60 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.1152 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 66 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3042 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.
units.verify: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。~Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.
units.failure: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。~Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails.
units.misconception: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度~Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
units.practice: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力~Long-rail temperature and restrained stress
units.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力~Long-rail temperature and restrained stress
units.mechanism: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 以高架曝曬段和隧道出口作為不同鋼軌溫度量測位置。~A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Use an exposed viaduct and a tunnel exit as contrasting rail-temperature measurement locations.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 33 K，其餘固定，結果為 79.695 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 33 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 79.695 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded.
units.verify: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。~Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle.
units.failure: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。~Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference.
units.misconception: 完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長~A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
units.practice: 畫出自由、部分拘束與完全拘束三種邊界，重算熱變形或應力，標明哪些輸入必須由鋼軌溫度及扣件試驗取得。 再以本單元 deltaT 的對照值重算 compression，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.title: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.mechanism: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。 此處以相同距離比較兩種波速，屬簡化幾何模型。實際感測站可能不在線路與震源之間；可用時間還包括資料品質檢查及保護命令發送，不能只比較波速。 把預警提前量與列車制動時間連結，辨認近場地震的限制。~Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time. An alarm therefore cannot make a moving train stop instantaneously, even when the detection itself works correctly. The exercise compares two wave speeds over the same distance and therefore uses simplified geometry. A real sensor may not lie between the source and railway. Available time also includes data-quality checks and protection-command delivery, not only wave propagation. Link warning lead time to braking time and identify the limitation of a nearby earthquake.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 110000 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.09524 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 110000 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.09524 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted.
units.verify: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。~Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components.
units.failure: 只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 感測成功不等於制動成功，須查列車收到命令後的動作。~Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. Successful detection is not successful braking; inspect the train response after command receipt.
units.misconception: 地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下~A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
units.practice: 將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Shorten source distance and double communication delay, calculate remaining lead time, and compare it with braking time without extending the conclusion beyond the model. Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.mechanism: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 在高架跨中區分列車載重撓度與支承位置的共同移動。~For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Separate load-induced midspan deflection from movement shared with the viaduct supports.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9082613 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 27.5 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.329785 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9082613 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.5 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.329785 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.
units.verify: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。~Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.
units.failure: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。~Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.
units.misconception: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成~Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
units.practice: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.title: 接觸線張力波速~Contact-wire tension wave speed
units.mechanism: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 在橋隧交界檢查接觸線張力與接觸品質的變化。~Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Examine contact-wire tension and collection quality across the transition between bridge and tunnel.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=20000 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=134.84 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 22000 N，其餘固定，結果為 141.4214 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=20000 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=134.84 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22000 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 141.4214 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed.
units.verify: 核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。 核對接觸線張力、單位長度質量及量測位置，並用接觸力和離線事件檢查動態品質。~Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks. Verify contact-wire tension, mass per unit length and measurement location, then examine contact force and loss-of-contact events for dynamic quality.
units.failure: 補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 波速符合估算仍可能離線，需查看接觸力的時間歷程。~A sticking tensioning device lets temperature change tension, while slack droppers change local dynamic stiffness; static wire height alone cannot identify either mechanism. Agreement in wave-speed estimates does not rule out contact loss; inspect contact-force histories.
units.misconception: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質~Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
units.practice: 將張力降低一成和線密度增加一成分別計算波速，列出尚需哪些接觸力量測才能討論動態受流品質。 再以本單元 tension 的對照值重算 wave_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Reduce tension and increase wire mass density separately by ten percent, calculate wave speed, and identify the contact-force measurements still needed to assess dynamic collection. Also recalculate wave_speed for the alternative tension value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 比較同方向追蹤列車與單獨列車對回送電能的接受條件。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare network receptivity with a following train and with an isolated train movement.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 264000 kg，其餘固定，結果為 14.89583 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 264000 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.89583 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.mechanism: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。~A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.352941 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2750 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.088235 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.352941 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2750 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.088235 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.
units.verify: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。~Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.
units.failure: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。~Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.
units.misconception: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口~A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
units.practice: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 在橋台與路堤銜接處設計足以辨認短波變形的測點。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Place survey points at a bridge-abutment transition densely enough to resolve short deformation wavelengths.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0132 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.66 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0132 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.66 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把供電與列車可用性分開，分析停駛時間是否由同一故障主導。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Separate power-system and fleet availability to determine whether one failure dominates downtime.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1200 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9966777 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1320 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9969789 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1200 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9966777 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1320 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9969789 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 2：v=60 m/s，計算 residual=0.1152 m/s^2；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: v=60 m/s, calculated residual=0.1152 m/s^2; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：deltaT=30 K，計算 compression=72.45 MPa；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: deltaT=30 K, calculated compression=72.45 MPa; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：distance=100000 m，計算 lead=9.904762 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: distance=100000 m, calculated lead=9.904762 s; not measured performance.
